title: Pullman's conservatory: the transept's windows drawn as its photographs show
items: The conservatory across 18th Street from the Pullman house has new windows along its transept arms. Each is now a tall light under a transom with a short round-headed light above it, in white framing, three to each side, as the 1894 Inland Architect plate and Lowe's c. 1897 photograph show them. They used to be square-headed panes in a dark grid.
Neither picture shows the west arm or the arms' ends face on, so those windows repeat the east side's spacing. That is recorded as a reconstruction.
